risks.risk: Reduced assurance may be mistaken for clean-room independent review.
risks.mitigation: Preserve reduced-assurance disclosure in every gate and package.

risks.risk: Six layers and fourteen volumes may be conflated.
risks.mitigation: Maintain distinct semantic-layer and engineering-group views with explicit mappings.

risks.risk: Derived guidance may be mislabeled as thesis implementation.
risks.mitigation: Bind every capability to thesis boundary category A-F.

risks.risk: BGE semantic generation may be mislabeled deterministic.
risks.mitigation: Claim determinism only for schemas, validation envelopes, hashes, and replayable inputs.

risks.risk: Runtime executor may accumulate policy authority.
risks.mitigation: Separate Policy Engine and Human gates; prohibit self-authorization.

risks.risk: Evidence storage may be treated as decision authority.
risks.mitigation: State that Evidence Ledger records proof and never adopts policy or architecture.

risks.risk: Health or VET-C concepts may contaminate Railway or MAGP Core.
risks.mitigation: Enforce adopted contamination policies and zero domain promotion.

risks.risk: Registry may grant capabilities instead of recording them.
risks.mitigation: Registry records Human/release decisions and cannot create them.

risks.risk: Runtime evidence may reverse-modify design artifacts.
risks.mitigation: Allow change proposals only; require design-time Human adoption for modification.

risks.risk: Architecture description may be mistaken for implementation readiness.
risks.mitigation: Keep architecture PROPOSED_NOT_ADOPTED and explicitly prohibit implementation.
